styles.hero: low-poly faceted 3D game character, visible flat-shaded polygon planes, lanky stylized proportions about 6.5 heads tall, thin limbs, large ears, big dark heavy-lidded eyes, deadpan expression, oversized shoes and headwear, clothing patterns painted as flat textures, soft even studio lighting, plain neutral gray background
styles.map: chunky blocky low-poly 3D game character with crisp pixel-art textures, about 4 heads tall, oversized sneakers, simple readable silhouette, saturated outfit colors, plain muted teal background
styles.prop: low-poly faceted 3D game prop, visible flat-shaded polygon planes, painted flat textures, soft even studio lighting, plain neutral gray background

sheets.label: Hero turnaround
sheets.why: Front, 3/4, side and back views. Used for modeling and AI image-to-3D. Run this first, then pick the best result: its image URL becomes this character's reference for the other sheets.
sheets.text: character turnaround sheet, same character shown four times: front view, three-quarter view, side profile, back view, full body, neutral standing pose, empty hands relaxed at sides, evenly spaced, orthographic
sheets.params: --ar 16:9 --style raw --sref {HERO_SREF} --no text, labels, instrument, perspective distortion, cropped feet

sheets.label: A-pose
sheets.why: Arms out at 45°, front and side. Used for rigging.
sheets.text: full body A-pose, arms angled 45 degrees down and away from the body, legs slightly apart, front view and side view side by side, orthographic, for 3D rigging

sheets.label: Expressions
sheets.text: expression sheet, head and shoulders, six panels: neutral deadpan, focused concentration, smug grin, surprised, triumphant cheer, defeated slump

sheets.label: Instrument
sheets.why: The drum on its own, front/side/top. Modeled as a separate part.
sheets.text: prop sheet of the instrument only, front view, side view and top view

sheets.label: Map version
sheets.why: Chunky pixel-textured version for the city map. A light character reference keeps the outfit without copying the lanky proportions.
sheets.text: turnaround sheet, front view, three-quarter view and back view, full body, playing their instrument
